intent: Shared categoryListing module (Press as thin wrapper), mediaVideo generalising Dinings section video to any data-video-link frame, Offers Slider Split counting slides from the page incl. Collection Lists.

actionable_findings.title: Zero slides now leaves arrows and placeholder counter visible (regression from base, which hid controls for slideCount < 2)
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the early `if (slideCount === 0) return` (or move it below the total label and `slideCount < 2` hide branch) so 0 slides hides controls as before; update the empty-list spec to expect hidden controls.

actionable_findings.title: Video/iframe is laid over the image before it plays: hero zoom hidden and YouTube chrome flash (contradicts hero-background-video learning)
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Append the player at opacity 0 and reveal it after `player.ready` resolves (with a ~4s fallback), so the image (and heroImageScale zoom) stays visible until the video actually plays.

actionable_findings.title: Every video frame preloads and autoplays at init, including long Collection Lists
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Keep preload 'none'/'metadata' and play/pause via IntersectionObserver near the viewport.

actionable_findings.title: Generic listing falls back to the page's first tab bar, so a second list overwrites the first list's tabs
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Use the document-level tab bar fallback only when exactly one list root exists on the page.

actionable_findings.title: Press 390 test duplicates the existing Press assertions
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Fold the 390 viewport into the existing Press test via a viewport loop instead of a copy.

residual_risks: With a Collection List, Swiper initialises on .w-dyn-list, which lacks the .swiper class, so Swiper's base .swiper CSS does not apply to the element it controls.
No re-init guard on Swiper (fine while called once).
Reduced motion read once at init.
testing_gaps: media-video fixture runs heroImageScale before mediaVideo, the reverse of src/index.ts order

coverage.peer: not-run: build pipeline requires every review-stage agent on Sonnet; in-process adversarial reviewer (Sonnet) covered the lens
coverage.notes: Merge, validation and report done by the lead from collected reviewer artifacts; separate merge/validator leaves not dispatched. Lead verified #1 against the base source.
